topic: waterproof a pair of hiking boots
core_question: How do you make hiking boots water-resistant before a wet trip? (secondary: How do I keep my passport and other travel documents safe and organized while traveling?)
answer_summary: Clean the boots and let them dry, then apply a waterproofing wax (for leather) or a spray-on treatment (for fabric/synthetic), following up with a second coat if needed.; after the topic shift: Keep passport, tickets, and ID in a single dedicated travel wallet/organizer kept on your person, and make photocopies or photos of each document stored separately (and in cloud storage) as a backup in case of loss.
